## What's new

### Remote server: read your agents' conversations as chat on the phone
On a paired phone, an agent pane now shows the agent's conversation (Claude
Code and Codex) as chat bubbles with rendered Markdown, instead of raw terminal
text. Tables, lists and code blocks read properly on a narrow screen, and a
wide table scrolls inside its own box. A **Conversation / Screen** switch
brings back the old screen view.

- **Where it comes from**: ymux reads the agent's own transcript file on your
  computer. Only your messages, the agent's replies and one-line tool calls
  leave the PC. They are end-to-end encrypted and redacted like everything
  else, and tool output is never sent.
- **A switch for it**: Settings > Remote server > **Show agent conversations
  on paired devices**, on by default. Turn it off and the phone gets the screen
  text only.
- **Needs the updated yMux-Server**: older servers and phone web apps keep
  working with the screen text view.

### Security
- Nothing new can be done from the phone: reading a conversation needs the
  same view access as reading a screen, and there is still no remote command
  for raw keys, new panes or files.
- The conversation is read only from the transcript of the agent that runs in
  that pane, and never by the web page. Reasoning and tool output are not
  included.

### Upgrade notes
- Nothing changes unless the remote server is switched on. Keep ymux and
  yMux-Server on the same minor version.
- If you do not want conversations on the phone, switch the new option off.
- No new keyboard shortcuts.
